title: Watermelon Rind Mac and Cheese
subtitle: with feta and a fresh chilli salsa
description: Baked pasta shells with mozzarella, feta, sour cream and za'atar, with chunks of watermelon rind folded through, served with a fresh grated tomato and watermelon salsa.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C and grease a casserole dish with olive oil.

In the dish, mix the cooked pasta, mozzarella, feta, sour cream, za'atar leaves from 3 stalks, salt, pepper and the watermelon rind (cut into large pieces, with the red and green parts removed). Cover and bake for 2 hours. Remove the lid, raise the oven to 220°C and bake for another 10 minutes until browned.
Make the salsa: mix the coarsely grated tomatoes, coarsely grated watermelon flesh, 2 tablespoons olive oil, sliced green and red chillies, za'atar leaves from 3 stalks, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Spoon the salsa over the hot pasta and serve immediately.
